sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive leadership and Energy dominate as Healthcare surges, while cyclicals and materials lose ground.

Market breadth remains narrow with only 3 of 11 sectors showing positive returns across all timeframes (week, month, quarter, half, YTD). Energy holds the top spot with a momentum score of 0.883, while Healthcare is actively rotating higher, gaining 3 spots over the last five sessions to reach rank 3 with a 0.867 momentum score. Consumer Defensive also supports the risk-off tilt, holding an all-green profile at rank 4 with 0.733 momentum.

Meanwhile, cyclical and economically sensitive sectors are fading. Basic Materials and Industrials experienced the sharpest declines, each dropping 2 spots over five sessions to rank 5 (momentum 0.383) and rank 6 (momentum 0.283), respectively. Consumer Cyclical sits at the bottom of the board at rank 11 with 0.350 momentum, while Utilities remains the weakest overall momentum laggard at 0.183 (rank 10).

## Strength
- **All-Green Breadth:** Only 3 of 11 sectors are positive across all time horizons: Energy (momentum 0.88), Healthcare (momentum 0.87), and Consumer Defensive (momentum 0.73).
- **Sustained Leaders:** Energy and Healthcare have maintained top-3 positioning across 1-month, 3-month, and 6-month ranks.
- **Top Momentum:** Energy leads all sectors with a momentum score of 0.883 (rank 1), closely trailed by Healthcare at 0.867 (rank 3) and Consumer Defensive at 0.733 (rank 4).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Healthcare Surging:** Healthcare gained +3 spots over the past five sessions, rising to rank 3 with a 0.867 momentum score.
- **Defensive Upward Drift:** Consumer Defensive picked up +1 spot to rank 4 (0.733 momentum), while Real Estate gained +1 spot to rank 8 despite a weak 0.267 momentum score.
- **Cyclical Fades:** Basic Materials (-2 spots to rank 5, momentum 0.383) and Industrials (-2 spots to rank 6, momentum 0.283) were the biggest five-day decliners.
- **Bottom Tier:** Utilities anchors the bottom with a 0.183 momentum score (rank 10), while Consumer Cyclical sits last in the table at rank 11 (momentum 0.350).

## Divergences
- **Technology vs. Rank:** Technology maintains strong YTD positioning at rank 2 and a high 0.717 momentum score, but it failed to qualify as an all-green sector alongside Energy, Healthcare, and Consumer Defensive.
- **Real Estate Rank Bump vs. Weak Momentum:** Real Estate gained +1 spot over the last five sessions to reach rank 8, yet it remains the second-weakest momentum group overall at 0.267.
- **Basic Materials Slippage:** Basic Materials fell -2 spots over five sessions to rank 5, dragging its momentum down to 0.383 despite maintaining a top-half YTD rank.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and healthcare maintain dominant leadership with 27 all-green groups, while cyclicals and tech software show early signs of momentum fatigue.

Energy and healthcare remain the bedrock of market strength, spearheaded by Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (0.910 momentum) and Diagnostics & Research (0.901 momentum). Both segments feature prominently among sustained leaders across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons. Meanwhile, consumer and business support pockets like Business Equipment & Supplies (+18 spots) and Healthcare Plans (+14 spots) are aggressively rotating upward.

In contrast, industrial cyclicals, materials, and transport groups are fading sharply. Engineering & Construction plunged 24 spots to rank 48, joined by heavy pullbacks in Silver (-21 spots) and Agricultural Inputs (-17 spots). Simultaneously, major tech segments—including Semiconductors and Software - Infrastructure—are beginning to flash early warning signs as their ranks slip despite high momentum scores.

## Strength
- **Resilient Core Leadership:** 27 of 144 industry groups are all-green across all timeframes, anchored by top momentum scores in Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (0.910, rank 1 YTD) and Diagnostics & Research (0.901, rank 30 YTD).
- **Persistent Outperformers:** Oil & Gas Integrated (0.876 momentum), Health Information Services (0.871 momentum), and Medical Distribution (0.869 momentum) continue to demonstrate sustained strength in the top 36 across 1-, 3-, and 6-month ranks.
- **Supportive Defensive Pockets:** Department Stores (0.84 momentum) and Drug Manufacturers - General (0.82 momentum) hold all-green status, showing broad institutional backing.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Rapid Short-Term Climbers:** Business Equipment & Supplies jumped 18 spots to rank 41 (momentum 0.76), followed closely by Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries (+17 spots to rank 62, momentum 0.76) and Shell Companies (+17 spots to rank 28, momentum 0.77).
- **Severe Industrial Drops:** Engineering & Construction collapsed 24 spots (rank 48, momentum 0.32), Silver fell 21 spots (rank 51, momentum 0.47), and Agricultural Inputs declined 17 spots (rank 52, momentum 0.38).
- **Persistent Momentum Laggards:** Mortgage Finance (0.016 momentum, rank 142 YTD), Gambling (0.037 momentum, rank 143 YTD), and Advertising Agencies (0.094 momentum, rank 144 YTD) remain anchored at the bottom.

## Divergences
- **Fading Tech and Quality:** Software - Infrastructure (momentum 0.72, -5 spots in 5d), Semiconductors (momentum 0.66, -6 spots in 5d), and Internet Content & Information (momentum 0.65, -5 spots in 5d) are losing rank despite elevated momentum.
- **Emerging Low-Momentum Rebounds:** Insurance Brokers (+11 spots in 5d, momentum 0.47) and Leisure (+9 spots in 5d, momentum 0.50) are staging sharp rank advances from previously muted momentum bases.
- **Consumer Defensives Awakening:** Travel Services (+7 spots, momentum 0.49) and Grocery Stores (+6 spots, momentum 0.46) are pressing upward, reflecting early rotational inflows.
